Title: Provider Health + Failover Foundation
Summary: HEALTH/FAILOVER DECISION FOUNDATION. Deterministic provider-health and route-failover foundation. Provider health is NOT model quality: health vocabulary reuses the DB-M14/DB-M20 failure vocabularies as AVAILABLE, RATE_LIMITED, DEGRADED, AUTH_ERROR, UNAVAILABLE, DISABLED, UNKNOWN with the fixed ProviderHealthEvidence v1 / ProviderHealthPolicy v1 / ProviderFailoverDecision v1 field lists. No hard-coded thresholds scattered in the implementation (all thresholds live on ProviderHealthPolicy v1). Circuit breaker CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN derives from failure threshold + cooldown (no uncontrolled network probing). Rate-limit is never a MODEL_QUALITY_FAILURE; RetryAfterUtc honored; DISABLED never auto re-enabled; AUTH_ERROR -> HUMAN_PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED, never model-escalated; UNKNOWN explicit, never silently AVAILABLE. Failover eligibility: a fallback route must already satisfy DB-M19 hard eligibility constraints -- hard filters are never bypassed because the preferred provider is down; if no healthy alternate route exists the decision returns that fact (NO_HEALTHY_ROUTE / WAIT_COOLDOWN / WAIT_RETRY_AFTER), never a fabricated fallback. DB-M20 integration: SWITCH_PROVIDER_ROUTE handling (git-gate HUMAN_* and non-RECOMMENDED statuses are NOT provider failures and never execute a switch); Test-AiBudget consumption -> over budget -> ROUTING_REPLAN_REQUIRED (never executable failover); failure-fingerprint suppression (never keeps retrying an identical known provider failure). Manual override requires explicit reference + reason + timestamp and never re-enables a config-DISABLED provider. Operating modes: MANUAL (display only) / ASSISTED (recommend, human triggers) / AUTO prohibited; AUTO_EXECUTION_ENABLED = FALSE. Eight operations: New-ProviderHealthEvidence, Get-EffectiveProviderHealth, Test-ProviderRouteAvailable, Get-ProviderCircuitState, Update-ProviderCircuitState, Get-EligibleFailoverRoutes, Get-ProviderFailoverDecision, Test-ProviderHealthOverride, Export-ProviderHealthReport. No operation executes an AI provider/model: 0 network calls, 0 paid API calls. Health aggregation priority DISABLED(config) > AUTH_ERROR > RATE_LIMITED > UNAVAILABLE > DEGRADED > AVAILABLE > UNKNOWN; UNAVAILABLE fires on ANY fresh UNAVAILABLE evidence (threshold reached OR cooldown pending). Provider failures are evidence-only signals, never Nexus roadmap tasks (FIX-TASK RULE: never NEW_FIX_TASK_REQUIRED unless an independently verified Nexus code failure; DB-M22 creates no Nexus tasks).

NotesForNextMilestones: DB-M25 (model quality) builds on DB-M22 health evidence: infrastructure failures (AUTH_ERROR/RATE_LIMITED/UNAVAILABLE) are recorded as provider health evidence, not model-quality failures; DEGRADED comes only from observed quality evidence; UNKNOWN is explicit so quality evaluation never silently treats missing evidence as good.
